explanation: The theorem is the universal property of the n-th roots of unity group scheme as the kernel of the n-th power map on the multiplicative group scheme over Spec K. Its proof uses the library's own pullback square, `rootsOfUnityPowerSquare_isPullback_over`, together with the generic `IsPullback.lift` lemmas. Mathlib has no declarations about `rootsOfUnityScheme` or `multiplicativeGroupScheme`; a grep of Mathlib for both names returned nothing. I found no Mathlib statement of this kernel property for group schemes.
